data.gender_notes: Keeley is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'ceal' meaning 'slender' or 'sleek'. The name may also have Celtic roots, meaning 'bright or handsome'. The name Keeley carries the meaning “Slender or sleek” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Keeley usually hope their child will grow to embody slender or sleek and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Κίλη
in_greek.meaning: Η Κίλη σημαίνει 'δύναμη του Θεού' ή 'ο Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κίλη προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή ρίζα 'קול' ή 'קלה', που σημαίνει 'δύναμη' ή 'Θεός'. Το όνομα Κίλη αποτελείται από τη ρίζα 'קו' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και την κατάληξη 'ילי' που σημαίνει 'δύναμή μου' ή 'μου'. in_latin.name: Keeley
in_latin.meaning: Keeley means 'God is my strength' or 'divine power'
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Keeley originates from the Hebrew root 'קול' or 'קלה', meaning 'strength' or 'God'. The name Keeley is composed of the root 'קו' meaning 'God' and the suffix 'ילי' meaning 'my strength' or 'of mine'. In the early Christian Church, the name Keeley signified the power of God that gives strength to His people.

in_english.name: Keeley
in_english.meaning: Keeley means a variant of Kelly, signifying 'slender' or 'strong'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Keeley is an English variant of the surname Kelly, which originates from the Irish surname 'Ó Ceallaigh', meaning 'descendant of Ceallach', where 'Ceallach' means 'slender' or 'strong'. The name Keeley has been adapted in Christian tradition to signify 'God is my strength' or 'divine power', reflecting its Hebrew and Greek roots.
